name: South Fork Flambeau River
gaugeName: SOUTH FORK FLAMBEAU RIVER NEAR PHILLIPS, WI
blurb: The South Fork Flambeau River through Price County toward the Flambeau River State Forest: quiet water, rapids and small dams.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.difficulty: Rapids and small rock dams (see DNR guide)
sections.notes: Start at the agency-listed Forest Road 144 access and finish at Smith Rapids. The guide’s Round Lake dam portage is upstream of this put-in. Scout the takeout near the covered bridge before launching; do not continue into Smith Rapids unintentionally.

notices.title: Rapids and rock dams
notices.text: Fish Trap, Little Bull and Riley Creek hazards precede Smith Rapids. Consult DNR page 14.
notices.sourceName: Wisconsin DNR — Paddle the Flambeau River, printed page 14

sections.routeReview: The available river line cuts across a present-day bend near Smith Rapids. Dotted geometry remains under review; exact landing and rock-dam approaches are not mapped.

sections.difficulty: Class I–III rapids marked in DNR guide
sections.notes: This reach ends at the Cedar Rapids bridge before the downstream Sugar Bush dam reach. Arrange your shuttle and confirm both bank approaches. This is a whitewater trip, not a casual tubing recommendation.

notices.title: Smith, Natural Dam and Cedar rapids
notices.text: Consult the DNR guide and scout conditions. These access areas do not identify a safe line through the rapids.
notices.sourceName: Wisconsin DNR — Paddle the Flambeau River, printed page 14

sections.distanceReview: The guide’s rough intermediate distances suggest about 3 miles, while the available USGS river line measures about 4.65 miles. Distance and time estimates are withheld until this discrepancy is resolved.
sections.routeReview: The river geometry and the guide’s intermediate distances disagree. No dotted path or landing connection is approved yet.
